scope: Bounded inspection of two previously undownloaded images in an already-known public corpus; no new search or denied-host retry.

entries.name: bionic

sourceRows.text: | MK-31 bionic | Bionic, PHG | vérifié (tête) | Separate head layer: glowing red cybernetic implant in place of the RIGHT eye, metal plates bolted onto skull and face. |

diagnosticOnBlack.scope: Browser display of original PNG on CSS black, not an edited asset.

observations: Two-tone stylized mechanical head graphic with no calibrated lighting/material volumes.
Bible explicitly requires a separate head layer with cybernetic right eye and implanted plates, not a detachable biomask.

entries.name: pirate

sourceRows.text: | MK-29 pirate | Pirate, PHG | vérifié | Half mask covering only the lower face (mouth and mandibles); separate layer: simple leather eyepatch over a clouded, scarred LEFT eye. |

diagnosticOnBlack.scope: Browser display of original PNG on CSS black, not an edited asset.

observations: A flat lower-face mask graphic with a separate eye patch at image-right/anatomical-left and upper hair/scalp silhouette.
The icon does not establish camouflage, leather/metal material, physical depth or hidden surfaces.
Do not convert its scalp/hair silhouette into a full biomask; the Bible specifies a lower-face half-mask.

decision: Do not expand the13rendered-mask batch from these UI symbols. Pirate remains insufficient for a faithful material sprite; Bionic is not a detachable mask.
